verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a dedicated Trade Marks & Brands practice whose international team of trade mark lawyers handles global portfolio management, brand protection programmes and complex disputes. An IP accolade separately supports its litigation strength for enforcement. Clearance searches and registration filing are not explicitly named, so not every element of the story is documented. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance/search services, explicit registration/prosecution filing, independent corroboration specific to trade marks.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Our international team of trade mark lawyers helps businesses protect, strengthen and unlock the value of their brands worldwide. From global trade mark portfolio management and brand protection programmes to complex disputes
Bird & Bird has a composite IP team that can handle all types of IP litigation, which is extremely rare among foreign firms.
